newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Ceska sporitelna raises key rates two points.
newsitem.headline: Ceska sporitelna raises key rates two points.

text.p: PRAGUE, May 25 (REUTER) - Ceska sporitelna is to raise its base deposit rates from 12.6 percent to 14.6 percent beginning Monday, May 26, bank spokesman Pavel Jirousek said in a press release.
Ceska sporitelna, the largest Czech savings bank, said it was raising interest on one-month deposits to 12-16 percent and on two-month deposits to 10-12.6 percent.
The Czech banking sector has been suffering from a lack of liquidity recently owing to restrictive monetary measures taken by the central bank.
On May 16 the central bank raised its Lombard rate from 14 to 50 percent in an attempt to defend the Czech crown, which was coming under heavy speculative pressure.
